feeds.title: Explore
feeds.description: Live nature cams, world-class wildlife photos, and educational films. explore.org is the philanthropic multimedia division of the Annenberg Foundation. Its mission is to connect people with extraordinary cultures and ideas, to inspire lifelong learning, and to cultivate the spirit of compassionate giving.

feeds.title: Conservation International
feeds.description: This blog is written by a diverse group of passionate people who believe in CI's mission to safeguard nature's critical services for the well-being of all of us. Authors include members of our global staff working in more than 25 countries, as well as valued partners with whom we team up to guide our efforts and extend our impact.

feeds.title: Mark Avery Blog
feeds.description: Mark Avery is an environmental campaigner, blogger, author and writer provides comments and views on nature conservation.

feeds.title: Nature Canada Blog
feeds.description: Your voice for nature! Our mission is to protect and conserve wildlife and their habitats in Canada by engaging people and advocating on behalf of nature.

feeds.title: PBS Nature Blog
feeds.description: The PBS NATURE blog delivers engaging, well-researched stories on wildlife, conservation, and environmental science—featuring guest contributions from organizations like WWF and WCS, fact sheets, and personal perspectives that connect people to the natural world.

feeds.title: Gulo in Nature
feeds.description: Gulo in Nature is an expert-led natural history, wildlife, and outdoor advice blog run by Dr. Charles van Rees, a professional conservation scientist, and naturalist. It features everything from travel tips, spotlights on fascinating plants and animals, and answers to everyday nature questions.

feeds.title: Wild Garden Expert
feeds.description: Uncover useful tips and advice on creating and maintaining your wild garden. Wild Garden Expert is a gardening resource offering a wide variety of features, including general garden advice, design inspiration, and fun children's gardening activities. Whether you're a seasoned gardener or just getting started, there's something here for you.

feeds.title: Potomac Creek: A blog on people, nature, and land
feeds.description: The natural history of all forms of life in a specific locale, as documented by a first generation immigrant.

feeds.title: Terra Marvels
feeds.description: At Terra Marvels, we celebrate the breathtaking beauty of our planet, from spectacular Earth formations to surreal natural wonders and everything in between. Whether it's the towering peaks of mountain ranges, unusual geological formations, or lush valleys teeming with life, we showcase the extraordinary diversity of our world.

feeds.title: Houston Arboretum & Nature Center Blog
feeds.description: Houston Arboretum & Nature Center offers an escape from the hustle and bustle of city life and the opportunity to experience the natural world. Its mission is to provide education about the natural environment to people of all ages and to protect and enhance the Arboretum as a haven and sanctuary for native plants and animals.

feeds.title: Reflections of the Natural World
feeds.description: Travel with me as I explore the wild things and wild places of our planet through my photo blog.

feeds.title: Bay Nature Magazine
feeds.description: Explore the natural world of Northern California with Bay Nature's in-depth articles, photography, illustration and events. Bay Nature connects the people of the San Francisco Bay Area to our natural world and motivates people to solve problems with nature in mind. Our vision is that all people have a close relationship with their natural world.

feeds.title: Nature Conservancy of Canada Blog
feeds.description: Written by conservation experts and professionals in the field, Land Lines offers a wealth of cool facts and thought-provoking reads about the Nature Conservancy of Canada's cutting-edge conservation research and discoveries. The Nature Conservancy of Canada (NCC) is Canada's leading national land conservation organization.

feeds.title: John Muir Laws Blog
feeds.description: John Muir Laws is a naturalist, artist, and educator who has dedicated his work to connecting people to nature through art and science. Posts on art, drawing, sketching, birds, nature, stewardship, conservation, and environmental education.

feeds.title: Ontario Nature Blog
feeds.description: Ontario Nature is the leading voice in the promotion and preservation of Ontario's natural environment through the creation of parks and nature reserves, the responsible management of forests, and the protection of rare, threatened, and endangered species.

feeds.title: After Nature Blog
feeds.description: The blog After Nature is a deeply reflective personal platform where the author explores intersections of nature, art, music, and philosophy, often weaving together speculative philosophy, metaphysics, and aesthetics through posts, curated podcast/mp3 content, and visual imagery.

feeds.title: Jessica's Nature Blog
feeds.description: Jessica's Nature Blog is written by Jessica M. Winder who has a background in ecological studies in both the museum and the research laboratory, is passionate about the natural world right on our doorstep, enthusiastic about capturing its beauty through photography.

feeds.title: Listening in Nature
feeds.description: I am a professional musician, educator, and naturalist. I study the songs of birds, insects and amphibians of NE Ohio and teach people not only to identify them, but also how to listen for their context and interactions.

feeds.title: Nature Moncton Information Line
feeds.description: We spend considerable time on all facets of Nature including Birds, Butterflies, Dragonflies, Moths, Mammals, Wild Flowers, Mushrooms, Fish, Amphibians, Astronomy, etc. Topics cover all aspects of Nature.

feeds.title: ShukerNature
feeds.description: ShukerNature explores cryptozoology & animal mythology - bigfoot, chupacabras, yeti, vampires, sea monsters, Nessie, sasquatch, dragons, mystery cats.

feeds.title: Valley Naturalist - A Natural History Journal For Gwent
feeds.description: Time served lifelong naturalist dispelling the myth that there's no wildlife in the South Wales valleys.

feeds.title: Weedon's World of Nature
feeds.description: Weedon's World of Nature is a nature-photography blog by Mike Weedon, showcasing stunning bird and wildlife imagery—especially moths, birds, spiders, otters, and more—captured across eastern England, often with insightful commentary.

feeds.title: Photography - Nature Photo Guides Blog
feeds.description: The Nature Photo Guides blog features articles, commentary, tutorials, and practical information for landscape and nature photographers, featuring the photography and writing of Sarah Marino and Ron Coscorrosa.

feeds.title: Canadian Museum of Nature Blog
feeds.description: At the Canadian Museum of Nature, we look after 14.6 million specimens. We also do research on those fossils, minerals, plants, and animals in our collections. And, we tell the world about what we have learned.This Blog brings you behind the scenes with our Research and Collections team. Whether it be tales from the lab, from out in the field, or from meeting the public, we hope you learn something new about nature and are inspired to further explore the natural world.

feeds.title: Shetland Nature Blog
feeds.description: Nature photography and wildlife encounters in the Shetland islands to compliment my wildlife tour company Shetland Nature.

feeds.title: Wild Ozark
feeds.description: Madison Woods blogs about life in the woods, creating earthy fine art at Wild Ozark. As an Arkansas Nature and Wildlife artist, she finds inspiration in nature's raw beauty. Using handmade paints from Ozark pigments, her art embodies the essence of the natural world.

feeds.title: Ohio Birds and Biodiversity
feeds.description: I am a lifelong Ohioan who has made a study of natural history since the age of eight or so - longer than I can remember. A fascination with birds has grown into an amazement with all of nature, and an insatiable curiosity to learn more. One of my major ambitions is to get more people interested in nature. The more of us who care, the more likely that our natural world will survive.

feeds.title: Lake County Nature
feeds.description: This blog is an active effort to keep readers informed of current natural events and to offer helpful suggestions for exploring local nature niches in Lake County, Illinois. feeds.title: Finding Nature
feeds.description: Psychologist researching improving connection with nature: Good for nature, good for you.

feeds.title: Notes from Nature

feeds.title: Birds and Nature

feeds.title: Southern Rockies Nature Blog
feeds.description: Where Nature Meets Culture-Plus Wildfire, Dogs, Environmental News, and Writing with a Southern Rockies Perspective.

feeds.title: Exploring Nature by Sheila Newenham

feeds.title: Crete Nature Blog

feeds.title: Art In Nature
